title.narrative: IEA Special report on sub-Saharan Africa’s energy outlook

description.narrative: Support to the development of a Special report on sub-Saharan Africa’s energy outlook will provide knowledge on the how Africa can secure an energy tranisiton that both enables universal access to energy by 2030 (SDG7) as well as an energy supply aligned with a climate neutral future (SDG13). Household energy and effects for women is a focus area, and the report will have disaggregated data on gender.
